votes.reason: JPM qualifies: it sits 1.0 widths above a 26-week channel line that rises 37% a year, and the weekly MACD histogram is rising with the MACD line above zero, so trend and momentum agree even though this is not a pullback entry.

REGN does not qualify because its 26-week channel falls 36% a year, and last week's jump to 3.1 widths above that falling line, with the MACD line still below zero, is a bounce against the trend rather than a pullback in a rising channel.

KO qualifies: it sits 1.9 widths above a channel line that rises 19% a year, and the weekly MACD histogram is rising with the line above zero, so although it is stretched rather than pulled back, nothing on the chart argues against it this week.

SCHW qualifies: it sits 1.8 widths above a gently rising channel line (+6% a year), and the weekly MACD histogram is rising with the line above zero, so both the channel and the momentum support holding it.

UNH qualifies and sits 1.3 widths below a steeply rising channel line, well short of a break, but the weekly MACD histogram is still falling, so the turn-up my rule needs before buying a pullback has not come this week.
